description: §52.8/§17.1 — a PUBLIC server-authority <each> (seeded, and with a fully SSR-renderable row template) that is ENCLOSED BY an `if=` element falls back to client-only first-paint render, and the compiler fires I-SSR-EACH-CLIENT-RENDERED (info) naming the enclosure. `if=` lowers to an inert `<template>` (§17.1 — it REMOVES, it does not hide), so the each's mount fence is not in the document tree at first paint and nothing spliced into it can paint. NO E-* — the each compiles and client-renders normally; only the SSR first-paint acceleration is declined.
rationale: g-ssr-each-under-if-blank-paint (S433). Before this, `buildSsrEachRenderers` threaded only `insideEach`, so an if-enclosed each was classified as a TOP-LEVEL server-render mount: the compose handler rendered the rows and spliced them INSIDE the `<template>`, producing a BLANK first paint on the dominant guarded-list shape (`<div if=@loaded>` around a server-authority list) at exit 0 with ZERO diagnostics. The each now takes the same conservative client-render fallback an unrenderable row template takes, and the existing info-lint names the enclosure instead of the row template (widening the renderable subset would change nothing here). Operator ruling S385: limb (a) — client-render fallback + the lint — NOW; server-rendering the resolvable branch is a separate arc.
